name: v2.8.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix printf format specifiers which cause issues on Windows by @fippo in https://github.com/cisco/libsrtp/pull/806
* Add API to require cryptex by @fippo in https://github.com/cisco/libsrtp/pull/805
* cryptex and enc xtn hdr is not a valid combination by @fippo in https://github.com/cisco/libsrtp/pull/811


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cisco/libsrtp/compare/v2.8.0...v2.8.1
